description: Flat metadata schema for individual 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing samples from microbial communities in Great Barrier Reef coral reef ecosystems, including spatial, environmental, and sequencing context.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample or record.

project_id.descr: Identifier for the broader study or project to which the sample belongs.

sampling_event_id.descr: Identifier linking samples collected at the same site/time expedition.

collection_date.descr: Date the sample was collected in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Local or UTC collection time if available, recorded as HH:MM[:SS].

reef_system.descr: Name of the reef system or region; for example, 'Great Barrier Reef'.

site_name.descr: Sampling site name or station designation.

site_code.descr: Short code for the sampling site, if used.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below sea surface (m). Use decimals if needed.

depth_zone.descr: Categorical depth zone, for example 'surface', 'shallow', 'mesophotic', or 'deep'.

distance_to_reef_m.descr: Distance to nearest reef feature or reference point in meters, if measured.

habitat_type.descr: Habitat classification at the sampling site, for example 'reef flat', 'fore reef', 'lagoon', or 'benthic water column'.

sample_material.descr: Material sampled, for example seawater, coral mucus, coral tissue, sediment, or biofilm.

host_species.descr: Coral or other host species name if the sample is host-associated; otherwise 'NA' or 'unassigned'.

host_condition.descr: Observed host condition, for example healthy, bleached, diseased, or stressed, if applicable.

water_temperature_c.descr: Water temperature at sampling in degrees Celsius (°C).

ph.descr: Measured pH at sampling site, on the reported scale and method used if known.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in mg/L, if measured.

turbidity_ntu.descr: Turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

nitrate_umol_l.descr: Nitrate concentration in µmol/L, if measured.

nitrite_umol_l.descr: Nitrite concentration in µmol/L, if measured.

ammonium_umol_l.descr: Ammonium concentration in µmol/L, if measured.

phosphate_umol_l.descr: Phosphate concentration in µmol/L, if measured.

silicate_umol_l.descr: Silicate concentration in µmol/L, if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in µg/L, if measured.

current_speed_ms.descr: Water current speed at the sampling site in m/s, if measured.

current_direction_deg.descr: Water current direction in degrees clockwise from north (0-359), if measured.

season.descr: Sampling season or survey period, for example 'summer', 'winter', or 'wet season'.

weather_conditions.descr: Brief description of prevailing weather or sea conditions during sampling.

sample_replicate_id.descr: Replicate identifier for technical or biological replicate samples collected from the same site/event.

replicate_number.descr: Numeric replicate index within the sampling event or site.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of seawater sampled in liters, if applicable.

filtration_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used for capture/filtration in micrometers (µm), if applicable.

preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample prior to DNA extraction, for example freezing, RNAlater, ethanol, or immediate extraction.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius prior to extraction.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol name used for the sample.

dna_concentration_ng_ul.descr: Extracted DNA concentration in ng/µL, if measured.

amplicon_target_region.descr: 16S rRNA gene region amplified, for example V3-V4, V4, or V4-V5.

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or name used for amplification.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or name used for amplification.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used for sequencing library construction.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, for example Illumina MiSeq or NovaSeq.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier or flow cell/run accession.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for each read, if applicable.

paired_end.descr: Whether sequencing was performed as paired-end reads (true) or single-end reads (false).

barcode_sequence.descr: Sample index or barcode sequence used for multiplexing, if applicable.

demultiplexed.descr: Whether reads were demultiplexed for the sample.

raw_reads_count.descr: Total number of raw sequencing reads obtained for the sample.

filtered_reads_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality filtering.

asv_count.descr: Number of amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) identified for the sample.

otu_count.descr: Number of operational taxonomic units (OTUs) assigned for the sample, if OTU-based processing was used.

taxonomy_db.descr: Reference taxonomy database used for taxonomic assignment, for example SILVA, Greengenes, or RDP.

pipeline_name.descr: Bioinformatics pipeline or software package used for processing, for example QIIME2, mothur, or DADA2.

pipeline_version.descr: Version of the bioinformatics pipeline or software used.

analysis_date.descr: Date when the sequencing data were processed or analyzed, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

data_accession.descr: Accession number or identifier for the raw sequence data in a public repository, if available.

metadata_version.descr: Version identifier for this metadata schema or record template.

quality_notes.descr: Free-text notes on sampling, sequencing, or processing quality issues relevant to interpretation.
